interpretations: Group Laboratory rows by patient ID. For each patient, calculate average PIC and the ratio of average HGB to average HCT, ignoring missing values in each average. Among patients with a defined ratio above the mean of all defined patient ratios, return one row containing the mean of their average PIC values, the mean of their ratios, and the mean of their ratios’ excess over the all-patient mean
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
all_patient_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
    AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.ratio - a.mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio_excess
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN all_patient_mean AS a
WHERE p.ratio > a.mean_ratio
